name: PDP Copy - Voice Training Setup
description: Learns brand voice from uploaded product descriptions. Analyzes tone, length, structure, and keywords to create a brand voice profile

parameters.prompt:
Analyze these product descriptions and identify the brand voice characteristics. Provide insights on:
1. Tone (professional, casual, luxury, technical, etc.)
2. Average sentence length
3. Commonly used words/phrases
4. Call-to-action style
5. Keyword focus areas
6. Typical structure/format

Descriptions to analyze:
{{ $json.descriptions.map(d => d.text).join('\n---\n') }}

Respond in JSON format:
{
  "tone": "description",
  "avgSentenceLength": number,
  "commonPhrases": ["phrase1", "phrase2"],
  "ctaStyle": "description",
  "keywordFocus": ["keyword1", "keyword2"],
  "structure": "description",
  "avgWordCount": number,
  "profile_summary": "2-3 sentence summary"
}
